name: PQ-11 Software-Only Ceiling Verdict
objective: Freeze the software-only post-quantum migration evidence into a deterministic evidence ledger, unresolved-boundary list, candidate comparison, migration-risk inventory and terminal shadow verdict without changing active FAE.
required_outputs: machine-readable evidence ledger binding PQ-00 through PQ-10 to exact commits/runs/artifacts
external-evidence boundary list kept separate from software blockers
candidate comparison using PQ-09 measurements without post-hoc scoring
exact reasons for every unresolved item

verdict_rules.MIGRATION_PATH_TECHNICALLY_VIABLE_IN_SHA: Allowed only when every required software gate PQ-03 through PQ-10 is GREEN, evidence bindings are complete, no unexplained differential disagreement remains, and no unresolved software blocker remains.
verdict_rules.BLOCKED_BY_UNRESOLVED_EVIDENCE: Required when any required software gate is not GREEN, an evidence binding is missing/inconsistent, or a software-relevant unresolved boundary prevents the viability claim.
verdict_rules.INSUFFICIENT_JUSTIFICATION_FOR_ACTIVATIO: May be used only as an activation disposition; it must never be converted into activation authority. A technically viable shadow path still does not justify activation by itself.

activation_disposition_rule: Activation is outside PQ-11 authority. Regardless of software-only verdict, activation_authorized remains false and production/mainnet decisions remain external.
external_evidence_not_software_blockers: PQ-12 optional physical-device measurements on iPhone/iPad if decision-relevant
anti_post_hoc_rules: do not invent thresholds after reading PQ-09 measurements
do not select a winning ML-DSA parameter set unless an already-frozen criterion requires it
do not erase failed historical runs; use admitted evidence lineage
distinguish software blockers from optional/external evidence
no new protocol implementation belongs in PQ-11
all conclusions must trace to existing immutable evidence
next_if_technically_viable: PQ-12 Physical-Device Evidence remains optional and decision-relevant only; otherwise the post-quantum software research workstream has reached its software-only ceiling.
